title: Non-Uniqueness for Nonlinear Fokker--Planck Equations and Their Associated Distribution-Dependent SDEs
summary: In this paper, we study distribution-dependent stochastic differential equations on the domain $\mathcal O=\mathbb T^d$ or $\mathbb R^d$, $d\geq 2$, of the form \begin{align*} {\rm d}X_t = v(t,X_t,ρ_t)\,{\rm d}t + \sqrt{2}\, σ(t,X_t,ρ_t)\,{\rm d}W_t, \qquad ρ_t:=\frac{{\rm d}μ_t}{{\rm d}x}, \end{align*} where $μ_t=\operatorname{Law}(X_t)$. Our main construction is carried out at the level of the associated nonlinear Fokker--Planck equations.
